# Girl's Flag Football | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.com

The Steelers continue to support girls with a passion for flag football by giving them the space to learn about the game, develop their skills, leadership and character both on and off the field.

Interested? Fill out the short form below to learn more!

#### Womens Flag Football

The Steelers Girls Flag Football Spring Season launched on March 29 at Saint Vincent College, featuring local college teams in the Showcase Game of the Week. Schools included Allegheny, Bethany, Chatham, Franciscan, Pitt, Saint Vincent, and Seton Hill. To grow women's flag football at the collegiate level, each participating team received a $7,500 grant from the Steelers and the NFL.

LEARN MORE

#### Girls Flag Big 33 Team

The Pittsburgh Steelers are proud to recognize the trailblazing athletes and coaches who represented the second annual Girls Flag Big 33 Team in this year's tournament. These standout athletes earned the opportunity to compete on behalf of the Steelers against top talent from across the region.
